verdict.rationale: Lium's own clusters feature puts several whole machines on the same RDMA fabric for one distributed job, which only loosely touches the private-networking half of the story. Nothing in the evidence documents exposing ports to serve applications from a pod; the Jupyter toggle is an adjacent feature, not general port exposure. missing for 10: documented port exposure/mapping for serving apps, private networking between independent pods (not just a cluster job), networking configuration details, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can expose ports to serve applications from my instance and connect instances over private networking

citations.quote: A cluster is several whole machines on the same RDMA fabric, for one distributed job.
